checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both hands remain closed around dumbbell handles throughout the lift.
checks.feet: Torso remains supported by 45-degree bench, feet stable; slightly bent arms lift laterally to shoulder level.
checks.movement: Chest supported on 45-degree bench, feet stable, neutral dumbbell grip, elbows slightly bent. Raise arms laterally to shoulder height, pause and lower without torso swing. 3.5 seconds lift, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.
